description.zh:
主叫侧放音编码，AXB业务时必须设置。必须包含3个场景的编码。按照“B->X,A->X,其他号码->X”的顺序填写编码，编码之间以逗号分隔。

> “1,2,3”表示B->X放音编号为1，A->X放音编号为2，其他号码->X放音编号为3。
description.en:
Caller-side ringtone code. This parameter is required for AXB scenarios. Must contain codes for 3 scenarios. Enter the codes in the order of "B->X, A->X, other numbers->X", separated by commas.

> "1,2,3" indicates that the ringtone code for B->X is 1, for A->X is 2, and for other numbers->X is 3.

description.zh:
接通后被叫侧放音编码，必须包含2个场景的编码。按照“A被叫,B被叫”的顺序填写编码，编码之间以逗号分隔。

> “1,2”表示A号码为被叫侧接听时的放音编号为1，B号码为被叫侧接听时的放音编号为2。
description.en:
Called-side ringtone code after connection. Must contain codes for 2 scenarios. Enter the codes in the order of "A as called party, B as called party", separated by commas.

> "1,2" indicates that the ringtone code when A is the called party is 1, and the ringtone code when B is the called party is 2.

description.zh: 区号。支持指定X号码归属地（指定城市->省会->全国路由）。不指定归属地，全国随机。
description.en: Area code. Supports specifying the home location of the X number (specified city -> provincial capital -> nationwide routing). If no home location is specified, a number is randomly assigned nationwide.

description.zh:
绑定类型。取值：

- mode101：客户指定X号码。

- mode102：平台分配X号码。
description.en:
Binding type. Valid values:

- mode101: Customer specifies the X number.

- mode102: Platform assigns the X number.

description.zh:
过期时间，单位：秒，取值：

- 0：永不过期。

- 其他数值：传其它数值时，比如60s，分配X号码成功的60秒内，绑定有效；超过60s后，自动解绑。
description.en:
Expiration time. Unit: seconds. Valid values:

- 0: Never expires.

- Other values: When other values are specified, such as 60, the binding is valid for 60 seconds after the X number is successfully assigned. After 60 seconds, the binding is automatically released.
Unique identifier of the message request.

description.zh: 外部业务扩展字段，通话记录回执消息中会回传此参数。不能超过100个字符长度。
description.en: External business extension field. This parameter is returned in call record receipt messages. Must not exceed 100 characters.

description.zh: 绑定时间，格式为yyyyMMddHHmmss。时间采用北京时间，24小时制。
description.en: Binding time. Format: yyyyMMddHHmmss. Uses Beijing time, 24-hour clock.

description.zh:
接通后主叫侧的放音编码，必须包含2个场景的编码。按照“A被叫,B被叫”的顺序填写编码，编码之间以逗号分隔。

> “1,2”表示A号码为被叫时主叫侧的放音编号为1，B号码为被叫时主叫侧的放音编号为2。
description.en:
Caller-side ringtone code after connection. Must contain codes for 2 scenarios. Enter the codes in the order of "A as called party, B as called party", separated by commas.

> "1,2" indicates that the caller-side ringtone code when A is the called party is 1, and the caller-side ringtone code when B is the called party is 2.

description.zh:
固话AXN分机号的A号码。

> A号码可设置为手机号码或固定电话，固定电话需要加区号，区号和号码中间不需要加连字符。
description.en:
The A number for the fixed-line AXN extension number.

> The A number can be set to a mobile number or a fixed-line number. Fixed-line numbers must include the area code, and no hyphen is needed between the area code and the number.

description.zh: 固话AXN分机号的X号码。X号码是您在控制台已[购买的隐私号](https://dyplsnext.console.aliyun.com/numberbuy)。
description.en: The X number for the fixed-line AXN extension number. The X number is a privacy number that you have [purchased](https://dyplsnext.console.aliyun.com/numberbuy) in the console.

description.zh: 分机号。BindType参数为mode101时此参数必填。
description.en: Extension number. This parameter is required when the BindType parameter is set to mode101.

description.zh: 业务时间戳，格式：yyyyMMddHHmmssSSS，时间采用北京时间，24小时制，精确至毫秒。
description.en: Business timestamp. Format: yyyyMMddHHmmssSSS. Uses Beijing time, 24-hour clock, accurate to milliseconds.

title.en: Bind AXN Extension Number for Fixed Line

descriptions.zh:
- 在调用此接口前，请确保您已在控制台[购买隐私号](https://dyplsnext.console.aliyun.com/numberbuy)。

- 您可以使用此接口给固话AXN分机号绑定号码，暂不支持在控制台给固话AXN分机号绑定号码。

- 绑定号码前建议您先明确业务场景中的A角色和N角色。例如：A号码是客户，则X号码是为客户分配的隐私号，其他的任何号码拨打X号码+分机号码都会转接到A号码，A拨打X的时候呼叫会转接到绑定时所传入的默认B号码。
descriptions.en:
- Before calling this API, make sure that you have [purchased privacy numbers](https://dyplsnext.console.aliyun.com/numberbuy) in the console.

- You can use this API to bind numbers for the fixed-line AXN extension number. Binding numbers for the fixed-line AXN extension number through the console is not supported.

- Before binding numbers, we recommend that you first clarify the A role and N role in your business scenario. For example, if the A number represents the customer, the X number is the privacy number assigned to the customer. Any other number calling the X number plus the extension number will be forwarded to the A number. When A calls X, the call will be forwarded to the default B number specified during binding.
